title: Hypha event schema (V0.5 E0)
description: Typed events written to vault/<slug>/events.jsonl. Backward-compat: legacy events without verification_channel / exec_result / answer_key_hash / irr_kappa / lifecycle remain readable.

lifecycle.description: Schema-Grounded Memory pattern (frontier 2026-05-02 arXiv 2604.27306+27906). Default: draft.

verification_channel.description: Non-LLM verification channel that judged this event's claim. 'none' = monitor-only telemetry.

answer_key_hash.description: sha256 of locked answer key (sealed_rubric channel).

irr_kappa.description: Cohen's κ on double-coded sample. IRR-before-F1 rule: must precede any F1 number.

tuple_id.description: Identifier for the (goal, instance, evidence) tuple this event belongs to.
